title: Victoria Government Gazette No. S 363, Tuesday 30 June 2026: notices of indexed benefit levels and other amounts from 1 July 2026
instrument_kind: Gazette notice (three notices in one Special Gazette)

contents.notice: Accident Compensation Act 1985: notice of indexed benefit levels and other amounts in accordance with Division 2D of Part IV
Workers Compensation Act 1958: notice of new benefit rates payable in accordance with section 9 and section 11
Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013: notice of indexed benefit levels and other amounts in accordance with Division 1 of Part 13
blank page and the Gazette's imprint and copyright notice

amounts_apply: rates from 1 July 2026 (and the rates before 1 July 2026); indexation by Victorian average weekly earnings, Dec 2024 to Dec 2025 (+2.350%), or Melbourne CPI, Dec 2024 to Dec 2025 (+3.093%), as each row is marked; the next notice is due for 1 July 2027
located: by reading the Gazette's 2026 archive list (issue number and date only) and the text of each General Gazette G17-G30 (23 Apr to 23 Jul 2026) and Special Gazette S260-S402 (26 May to 10 Jul 2026); the site's search form (an HTTP POST) was not used

text.conversion: plain text converted by Legalese Commons with pdftotext 4.00 (xpdf) -table -enc UTF-8, which keeps each table row's Section, Provision and two rate columns on one line; then, per page, tabs expanded, trailing spaces stripped and the blank line that table mode puts after every line removed; pages joined with one blank line, keeping their printed running heads; a notice block prepended. The words of -table output were checked against -layout output: the same 5,333 words in both. Paragraph breaks are not shown. No formula is lost; no sidecar is needed.
known_conversion_artefacts: rows that give two amounts (a base amount and a per-percentage-point amount, e.g. s 211(2)(b)-(e), s 212, s 213, s 214A) show the second amount on the next line under the first, as in the Gazette, without a label
the Workers Compensation Act 1958 table (pages 9-10) lists amounts against clause numbers only, as in the Gazette
the copyright symbol before 'State of Victoria 2026' on page 20 is not extracted

terms.licence: none (Copyright Act 1968 notice); deposited under the owner's ruling of 24 October 2026
